title: Integer scaling of the top restriction coefficient
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite, and let $k\ge1$ satisfy $|J|\le k$. There is an integer $z$ such that the top restriction coefficient of $f$ on $J$ equals $z\,2(1/2)^k$.
